Sixteen poisoned arrows (b-q) with cane shafts, barbed iron heads, fibre and reptile skin bindings. 3 arrows (r-t) with cane shafts, barbed iron heads, fibre and reptile skin bindings, painted along shaft with patterns in red pigment. Two arrows (u-v) with cane shafts, barbed iron heads, fibre bindings, painted along shaft with patterns in black pigment. Two arrows (w-x) with cane shafts, barbed iron heads, fibre bindings, painted along shaft with patterns in red pigment. Three arrows (y-aa) with cane shafts, barbed iron heads, fibre bindings. One arrow (ab) with cane shaft and barbed iron head. One arrow (ac) with cane shaft, iron head and fibre binding.
